sections.content:
When encouraging friends before a challenge or exam, these declined pronouns convey reassurance:
- *Bízom benned!* (I believe in you!)
- *Számíthatsz rám!* (You can count on me!)
- *Minden rajtad múlik!* (Everything is in your hands / depends on you!)
- *Gondolunk rád!* (We'll be thinking of you!)

items.english: Don't be nervous, we believe in you very much!
Wait for us after the exam!
